title: Continuous linear retraction onto a finite subextension of the normed algebraic closure
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended absolute value, and finite intermediate fields $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. There exists a continuous $E$-linear map
$$p_F:\Omega\longrightarrow F,\qquad p_F(a)=a\quad(a\in F),$$
where all fields have their norm topologies. Only linearity and continuity are required: $p_F$ need not be multiplicative, Galois-equivariant, or have operator norm at most one. No completeness of $\Omega$ is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent arithmetic expansion: continuous linear retraction used to detect a finite-field cocycle boundary. WANTED: nonarchimedean Hahn-Banach over the spherically complete local field E; no real/complex Hahn-Banach theorem is invoked.
